evidence.reason: The current tip already handles the interrupted-enqueue stale inbox case. For non-PR items it scans existing inbox jobs and adopts their prior `repair_base` before building the new record (lines 127-136), so `harvest`'s predecessor comparison uses the same base as the retained job. It also rebinds a stale orphan that never produced a result (lines 162-165). This removes the alleged permanent `repair predecessor mismatch` crash. Fixed by commit 517c970d7b07eb766fee9bd34b0797e39de39fd2.
